column8: Wed 25 Nov: 3e and 3c: Treasury's promise ends at the Fed credit, so guaranteed stays true and the last mile is a list of checks; say it in one clause, no legal detail.

Wed 25 Nov: 3e and Table 3 note: a wire stuck after the Fed credit is never a Treasury default or a missed deposit, so IPS l.17 stays narrow; the link to Table 3 is Keel's reading, check the wording before use.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 row 4 note only: the no-market days 16-18 Dec add one fact to Q26-017 and Q117-018; say the fund is held to its end, and never call its payout fixed.
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: liquidation costs in the final NAV are the reason the margin exists (NUMBERS 3, card Q3c); add only the filing's sentence, never size the cost here.
Wed 25 Nov: the notice lead times and the October release are Q151-005's; Table 3 row 4 already watches the notice.
Wed 25 Nov: 3e at most: one fund on one date; waiting money inside the fund earns bill rates, which the zero-interest standard already covers.
Wed 25 Nov: restates NUMBERS When the cash arrives (waits by holding); nothing new.
Wed 25 Nov: restates the standard if cash waiting earns nothing; a wire's days add no new risk; nothing new.
Wed 25 Nov: the T+1 sale is Q16 row 13 applied to TNA note 1; a Table 3 note at most.
Wed 25 Nov: Taiwan's form is out of the case's scope; a Table 3 note at most, never a step in 3e.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: name the residency's US-dollar account in the standing instruction; bank practice, never legal advice.
Wed 25 Nov: only use is one bank's counter rule, so a Table 3 note at most; say many banks, never all, and never as law.
Wed 25 Nov: one institution's form; out of scope, a note for Table 3 at most.
Wed 25 Nov: a post office's rule on expired papers; out of scope, a note for Table 3 at most.
Wed 25 Nov: the yearly limit is Q69 row 32; the per-conversion line is Taiwan legal detail, out of scope.
Wed 25 Nov: Taiwan legal form is out of scope; keep as a fact, never advice, and never in the report.
Wed 25 Nov: a purpose code is a bank form; out of scope and not a reason to change the plan.
Wed 25 Nov: a receiving fee of about US$24 is below any figure the report prints; store only.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: deductions along the way make the residency get a little less than $50,000 unless the sender covers them.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: the standing instruction says DEBT (OUR); KGI says it still does not guarantee full arrival.
Wed 25 Nov: a bank's list of correspondents; process detail, store only.
Wed 25 Nov: address rules for wires; process detail, store only.
Wed 25 Nov: conflicting sources on Swift's date; the report need not mention addresses, so store only.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: ask the broker for the wire's tracking reference and look for the credit confirmation.
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: the slow step in a cross-border payment is the receiving bank, so the plan allows a week and watches the Taiwan side; one sentence.
Wed 25 Nov: 3e: a $50,000 wire is retail, with 59.8 percent credited in a day (FSB 2026), so allow several business days; cite the FSB, never as a Laura figure.
Wed 25 Nov: regional detail of the same FSB report; Asia-Pacific figures add no decision.
Wed 25 Nov: banks' guide days (2-5, 2-7) support the allow-a-week line already in row 26.
Wed 25 Nov: a target, not a speed; the row itself says never quote it, and it serves no part.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: read each June's FSC table for the coming year-end; supports row 32.
Wed 25 Nov: supports row 32 only; Taiwan holiday law, store only.

Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most for Dec 2032 and 2038: Taiwan's banks close a day before the Fed; Keel arithmetic on rules that may change, so say on today's rules and send early, never a plan change.
Wed 25 Nov: the offsets were not read at source; read them (UTC+8 and UTC-5) before any send-by date is used.
Wed 25 Nov: December 2032 is the biggest month (NUMBERS 8w), but the facility contribution's payee is open; say rehearse the first January, never a new step.
Wed 25 Nov: 3e or the yearly calendar: the case says the beginning of the year, so the team writes one working meaning; a delay is never a reason to change.
Wed 25 Nov: Fedwire hours and Fidelity's 4 p.m. cut-off; routine, store only.
Wed 25 Nov: the 3 percent and Schwab's US$25 are page excerpts only; quote neither until read in full.
Wed 25 Nov: 3d: US dollars into a US-dollar account keeps the co-sponsor letter's sentence true and leaves the NT$ rate with the residency, as the letter already says.

Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note at most: the SEC letter covers advisers with custody, not a self-directed account; say standing instruction with a fixed payee and a yearly reconfirmation, never that the letter applies.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note: confirm any changed account details by a second channel; the likeliest failure is email fraud, never a market fall; US complaints only.
Wed 25 Nov: Table 3 note: send early in the window so a wrong wire can be recalled and re-sent before January; one bank's figures.
Wed 25 Nov: three of four years from secondary tables and closure length unread; matters only if a payment slips three weeks, so store only.
Wed 25 Nov: a list of process checks for 3e or Table 3 note; keep them as checks with owners and dates, none a reason to change the plan, and never call them automatic.
Wed 25 Nov: the off-list is the mirror of row 43; one line for Table 3's discipline.
